summary: GrowHub Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of CFO Poh Chit Wen, effective upon mutual agreement, due to personal reasons, not a disagreement. The filing is routine disclosure of a senior officer departure, not a hostile or scandal-driven change. No financial terms, board action, or advisors are mentioned. Per the classification guidelines, a voluntary C-suite resignation is treated as a management change event, though the contextual absence of conflict suggests a low-stakes transition. What to watch: the timing of the effective date and any successor appointment.
